ev.q: The Talos Principle is a 2014 puzzle video game developed by Croteam
The game features a philosophical storyline
the difficulty curve is one of the most finely crafted I have ever experienced
it becomes evident that these worlds exist only in virtual reality
the player can explore the open environments to find computer terminals
The player character, an unnamed android, awakes in a serene environment
Croteam has built a challenging, beautiful game
